primary_experiment.primary_source: Smith et al. 1971 ApJ165 217, Table1 first row and Table2 present work
primary_experiment.method: 83 keV beam-foil; velocity measured after foil; cascade-corrected two-exponential fit
primary_experiment.uncertainty_convention: Reported combination of statistical rms fitting errors and beam-velocity error (4%); combination rule/confidence not specified sufficiently for calibrated Gaussian scoring
primary_experiment.dependence: One upper lifetime; shared velocity calibration and cascade/background fit. Brooks1977 1302A is borrowed Smith1971, not independent. Recommended f=0.048±0.003 combines other studies and is not an additional observation.
primary_experiment.exposure: EXPOSED_NONBLIND; value already visible in Li2023 comparison before primary acquisition

rejected_attempts.coarse_reference_v1_v2: Native strict1s criterion exhausted500 cycles; finer consistent grid required, no layer promoted
rejected_attempts.mchf_v1: Wrong HF fixed-width closed-shell layout creates invalid s orbital and NaN/failed equations; partial seeds and downstream outputs rejected
rejected_attempts.mchf_v2_n5: No native orbital-stop marker after500 cycles; maximum function-change floor above requested tighter criterion. Preserve, do not score n5

cache_policy: Native mcp.* and explicitly hashed rci.res restart matrix caches retained on Sirius. Offline verifies all archived result material and matching external-cache metadata; it does not reread external cache bytes.
